_note: Case of the Week registry - the single source of truth for the weekly case section. To add a week, PREPEND one object to 'weeks' (newest first) and drop the two source .md files (ms3_src, res_src) into this folder. build_deploy.py (MS3 site) and resident_section.py (resident site) read this file to copy the pages and generate the nav section; no edits to those scripts or to site_manifest.json are needed. Built slugs are derived deterministically: cotw_<YYYYMMDD>_<topic>_ms3.md and cotw_<YYYYMMDD>_<topic>_res.md. Keep 'topic' short, lowercase, and unique per date. OPTIONAL per-week fields, all defaulted so an entry written without them still builds: 'blueprint' (list of shelfBlueprint codes - this is what puts the case on the curriculum crosswalk; vocabulary in CROSSWALK_TAXONOMY.md), 'epa' (AAMC EPA1..EPA13), 'read' (int, estimated read minutes), 'tldr' (one-line summary shown above the prose). These feed cotw_meta.py, which derives each case's topic_meta entry at build time so topic_meta.json never needs a weekly hand-edit.

weeks.label: Catatonia (Aug 31)
weeks.tldr: A mute, motionless patient is an emergency until proven otherwise - screen with the BFCRS, test-and-treat with the lorazepam challenge, hold the antipsychotics, and know the malignant-catatonia triggers that mean early ECT.

weeks.label: Borderline Personality Disorder (Aug 27)
weeks.tldr: A third admission, a five-drug regimen, and a 'treatment-resistant bipolar' label that was never right - BPD is diagnosed from the longitudinal pattern, treated definitively with psychotherapy, and managed on a chronic vs. acute-on-chronic risk frame.

weeks.label: Panic Disorder (Aug 10)
weeks.tldr: The cardiac workup is negative and the patient goes home no better - panic disorder is a positive diagnosis with a short list of must-not-miss mimics, and the disability lives in the avoidance, not the attacks.

weeks.label: Lithium — Monitoring & Toxicity (Aug 3)
weeks.tldr: A stable patient, an unchanged dose, and a level that tripled - lithium clearance is what changes, and in chronic toxicity the serum number understates how sick the patient is.

weeks.label: Opioid Use Disorder (Jul 27)
weeks.tldr: One encounter, two failures: a COWS-threshold buprenorphine start precipitated withdrawal in a fentanyl-exposed patient, and the recovery is methadone or low-dose initiation - with acute pain treated alongside the MOUD, never instead of it.

weeks.label: Alcohol Withdrawal & DT (Jul 26)
weeks.tldr: Time since last drink organizes everything: DT arrives late (48-96 h), PAWSS predicts and CIWA-Ar measures, and thiamine goes before glucose.

weeks.label: Suicide Risk & Safety Planning (Jul 23)
weeks.tldr: Risk formulation over risk category - the limits of stratification scores, and collaborative safety planning as the actual intervention.

weeks.label: MDD — Treatment Selection (Jul 20)
weeks.tldr: Switch, augment, or optimize when an antidepressant is not working - and how to tell an inadequate trial from a true non-response.

weeks.label: Bipolar Mania (Jul 20)
weeks.tldr: Recognizing a manic episode, screening for secondary mania, and choosing first-line acute treatment.

weeks.label: Acute Agitation & Delirium (Jul 13)
weeks.tldr: Treat the driver, not the behavior: de-escalation before PRN, PRN before restraint, and delirium until proven otherwise.

weeks.label: Serotonin Syndrome vs NMS (Jul 9)
weeks.tldr: Telling the two hyperthermic toxidromes apart - onset, reflexes, and rigidity - and managing each correctly.
